help.body:
HOW TO USE
1) Run the game in English and in Borderless Windowed mode.
2) Panel > 'Pick region': with a tooltip open, draw a box around it on the screen captured after 5 seconds.
3) Choose a scan mode and press 'Start':
   • Hotkey: hover over an item and press F8 (or the key you chose).
   • Automatic: open the inventory and move over items; it reads by itself once the tooltip settles. Use it in the inventory/stash, not while playing.
4) Verdict: KEEP / CONSIDER / DISMANTLE / CHECK IT.

LANGUAGE
The interface language is set in Settings. To add one, copy lang/en.json, translate the values and save it as lang/<code>.json — the app finds it on the next start. Saved builds, projects and progress are stored with fixed internal IDs, so switching language never loses them.

MISSING-PIECE TRACKING
Items that come out as KEEP and whose slot is detected (Mask, Backpack, Chest, Gloves, Holster, Kneepads and Weapon/Sidearm) are recorded into the slot of the best matching build. If the slot was empty it says FILLS A GAP; if the new item is better it says UPGRADE; if the one you have is better, KEEP is lowered to CONSIDER. Weapon/Sidearm comes from the weapon type in the tooltip (Assault Rifle, SMG, Pistol and so on); it cannot tell 'primary' from 'secondary', so every non-pistol weapon counts as one Weapon slot. Records live in progress.json and can be edited by hand.

ROLL COMPARISON
When an item is compared against one already recorded, the output box shows the difference attribute by attribute, e.g. 'weapon_damage: 10.2 → 11.5 (↑1.3)'. The comparison uses the values from the moment you recorded the piece.

EXPORT / IMPORT BUILDS
From the Builds tab you can save all your builds to a .json file and move them to another computer or send them to a friend. On import, a build with a name that already exists gets '(2)' appended instead of overwriting.

STATISTICS
Every scan is written to loot_log.csv; the Statistics tab shows the verdict breakdown, KEEP count per build, scans per day and the slot breakdown.

PROJECTS
Tracks projects under Daily, Weekly, Journey, Global Event, Manhunt and Other.
• To add one, paste the English text from the game, or use '📷 Read from screen' to OCR the project list that is open in the game into the text box, then press 'Translate and add'. Paste several projects on separate lines and each is translated and added separately.
• Translation uses the AI provider chosen in the Assistant tab (Ollama/Claude/ChatGPT). If none is set up or it does not answer, a small built-in dictionary does a rough job and the row is marked 'dictionary' — wording may be clumsy, so check the English original for anything important. If your language file has no dictionary, the original text is kept as is rather than mistranslated.
• Double-click a row or use '✔/✘' to mark it done. Daily and Weekly lists clear themselves at the reset hour/day you set; the other categories you clear by hand.
• 'Fetch automatically from ChatGPT' is a keyboard/window macro that types into your installed ChatGPT app and reads the answer off the screen. Define ChatGPT's answer area once with 'Pick answer region', then press the key (F10 by default) or click 'Run now': the request is sent, it waits, then the answer is read and split into categories. The section headings are always requested in English so parsing works in every language, while the task text comes back in yours. If the timing is off, '📖 Read answer now' re-reads without sending. What ChatGPT says may be out of date or wrong (a model that cannot browse may invent it), so always check the raw answer.
• IMPORTANT: this program does not pull projects from Ubisoft's servers or any website — there is no official API and site layouts change often, so take the current list from the game itself (Projects / Seasonal Journey / Global Event menus). Reset times have also been changed by Massive in the past; verify the defaults in game.

ASSISTANT
• Spoken verdict: when an item is scanned it reads something like 'Keep. Striker, 90 percent. Gloves. Fills a gap.' A voice package for your language must be installed in Windows.
• Voice command: press the voice key (F9 by default), speak, press again. A local Whisper model turns it into text.
• Chat: Local (Ollama, offline), Online (Claude API) or Online (ChatGPT API) — the online ones need your own API key; a ChatGPT Go subscription does not include one, it is obtained separately from platform.openai.com. The assistant knows your builds, your recorded and missing pieces, the last item and the history.
• If the AI does not answer it falls back to simple built-in replies (missing pieces, statistics, last item).

LOG
Everything the app does is written to logs/app.log. The Log tab shows it with a level filter, and lets you save a copy or clear it. If something goes wrong, that file is the first place to look — and the best thing to attach when asking for help. Level, maximum file size and number of kept backups are set in Settings.

TIPS
- If reading is wrong, use 'Test from screenshot' to see the OCR text; last_crop.png is the last capture taken.
- Write talent and set names exactly as they appear in the game. The slot is found from a word in the first lines of the item name (Mask, Gloves, Assault Rifle...).
- This program never touches the game's memory, it only reads the screen. Automatic mode captures the screen continuously, so do not assume zero risk with respect to Ubisoft.

set.art_note: You can add your own images: art\backgrounds (backgrounds), art\emblems\<build name>.png (build emblem), art\flags\<language code>.png (flag). Emblems and flags show for 5 s when selected.
meta.not_configured: The meta feed address isn't set yet.
meta.failed: Couldn't get the meta list (offline?). Using the last copy.
meta.up_to_date: Meta builds are up to date.
meta.locked: 🔒 You edited this meta build; sync won't change it anymore.
meta.enable: Sync automatically once a day at startup
meta.note: Meta and much-discussed builds are pulled from a central list once a day. Your own builds are never touched; a meta build you edit is locked, one you delete won't come back. ⭐ = meta, 🔒 = edited by you, 🔥 = popularity.
tasks.feed_note: The game's Projects, Journey and Manhunt tasks come from a central list in your language (🌐). Your 'done' marks are kept and expired tasks disappear on their own. Tasks you added yourself are never touched. Reset times are converted from the game's official time to your time zone.
tasks.how_pick: Pick a task; how to complete it appears here.
tasks.how_none: No tip for this task yet. New tips arrive as the shared list is updated.
tasks.projects_note: Daily and weekly projects aren't published on public sites, so they're read from your own screen: open the Projects screen in the game, pick 'Projects – Daily' or 'Projects – Weekly' and press '📋 Read projects screen'. The first time you select the list area once; after that it's one click. Tasks are translated into your language and a matching tip (💡) is added automatically.
tasks.nothing_read: No readable text found on screen.
wiki.enable: Read the Wiki automatically at startup
wiki.status: 📚 Wiki: {season} · {manhunt} Manhunt Scouts · {journey} Classified Assignments · {projects} seasonal projects · last read {when}
wiki.note: The Division Wiki (thedivision.fandom.com) is read live from your computer: the current season's Manhunt Scouts, Classified Assignments (with puzzle/ECHO tips) and dated seasonal projects. When a new season starts the app moves to the new page by itself. Wiki content is CC BY-SA and every task links to its source (📚).
scan.minimized: The app window was covering the scan area, so it was minimized to avoid reading its own text.
note.rare_unused: Rare item not in your builds. Keep it if you don't own one yet; otherwise you can dismantle.
build.name: Name
build.wtype_guess: Not set; guessed from the name: {types}

v3d.bars_hint: Drag to rotate · click a bar for details
disp.not_found: The Division 2 settings were not found (Documents\My Games\Tom Clancy's The Division 2\state.cfg). Start the game once.
disp.requirements: Recommended: game language English, HDR off, borderless/windowed mode, game resolution = monitor resolution.
disp.no_game_file: Game settings file not found — the tool still works, recommendations cannot be checked.
disp.game_file_bad: Game settings file could not be read.
disp.hdr_on: HDR is ON — colours change and OCR gets worse. Turn HDR off in game.
disp.exclusive: Exclusive fullscreen — the overlay may not be visible. Use borderless (windowed fullscreen).
disp.res_mismatch: Game resolution {game} differs from monitor {mon} — screen reading may be scaled. Use the native resolution.
disp.all_good: Game settings look good for screen reading.
ocr.note: Threshold separates text from background (raise it if letters merge, lower it if letters break). Auto calibrate tries combinations on the last card read and picks the one that recognizes most.
ocr.need_card: Read an item card first (F8 in game) — calibration and preview use the last card.
disp.lang_not_en: Game language may not be English (language index {n}) — item names are matched in English; set the game to English for best results.
disp.enlarge_ui: "Enlarge UI" is on — item cards are bigger; OCR scale is detected automatically, run Auto calibrate once.
note.kind_weapon_mod: Weapon mod — unlocked permanently, no keep/dismantle decision needed.
note.kind_skill_mod: Skill mod — check it against your skill builds manually.
note.kind_cache: Cache — open it, then scan the items.
note.spec_weapon: {spec} specialization weapon — keep it (not normal loot).
note.partial_card: Only the lower part of the card is visible (scrolled). Scroll up and scan again — both readings will be merged.
note.no_item: This is not an item card (menu, map or activity screen).
note.named_unused: Named item that no build uses — check it for the library/recalibration before dismantling.
note.merged: Scrolled card: top and bottom readings merged.
err.no_stt: No speech recognizer found. Install faster-whisper (Python 3.13) or a Windows speech language pack.
ai.diag_py: faster-whisper has no package for this Python version yet. Start the app with run.bat (it prefers Python 3.13).
set.save_hint: Changes on every page are saved together.
overlay.note: The overlay appears next to the item card in borderless/windowed mode. In exclusive fullscreen Windows may hide it.
disp.low_res: Small-screen mode: the window and text were scaled down to this resolution. In game, text this small is harder to read — check OCR → Auto calibrate.
disp.profile_mismatch: Window scaled to {prof}. Your monitor is {mon}; if the game runs at another resolution, set it in the game or choose Automatic.
plan.not_in_build: {slot} is not part of the active build.
plan.progress: {have}/{total} slots filled · {full} fully match the build
plan.missing_hint: Not found yet — scan matching drops with F8; a fitting item is recorded here automatically.
note.fills_gap_done: Fills the empty {slot} slot of {build} and meets every requirement ✔
build.complete: Build {build}: every slot has a piece! Check the ◐ slots for better rolls.
build.complete_full: 🎉 Build {build} is COMPLETE — every slot meets all requirements!
fx.cursor_note: Generic weapon silhouettes and sights (no game logos). Pick "My own image" to use your own picture as the cursor.
fx.no_backend: install the optional 'av' package (run.bat does it)
fx.video_note: Plays clips silently behind the header. The app makes its own original animated backgrounds (hex scan, radar, winter city, embers, tactical map, storm — drawn in code, no game footage). 'Multiply' adds 6 new variations; you can also add your own recordings.
disp.restarting: Switching to {prof} — the app reopens in a moment…
cl.box: Fetch current tasks with Claude Code
cl.note: Claude Code searches the web (official Ubisoft news, patch notes, The Division Wiki) for the current season's Journey missions, Manhunt scouts and active projects, and adds them in your language with a short how-to. Uses your Claude subscription through the Claude Code app, like the Assistant tab; no screen macro, no ChatGPT window.
cl.nothing: Claude found no tasks it could confirm. Try again later or sync the wiki.
cl.working: Claude is searching the web… (can take 1–3 minutes)
tasks.dbl_hint: Double-click a task (or press Enter) to open its details with pictures.
tasks.images_loading: Loading pictures from The Division Wiki…
tasks.no_images: No picture found for this task.
tasks.not_translated: Not translated yet — shown in English
fx.webp_note: {n} .mp4 file(s) need the optional 'av' package (start with run.bat); animated .webp versions are used instead.
